title: Deleted, with Undo
note: After the confirm, the Book is back at once: the card goes back into its row and leaves it, and one toast above the tab bar says "Letter deleted." with Undo and Close. It has no timer; leaving the Book takes it away. The letter waits in Recently deleted for 30 days.
text: Asha's book Read together This month 7 October 31 to November 29 Month 6 2 letters · From Mama September 30 to October 30 Tuesday, October 27, 2026 Bath time. You splash with your whole body, both hands, both feet, and then you check that I saw. From Mama Thursday, October 8, 2026 You rolled over all by yourself, twice, and then looked at me like you had always known how. From Mama Private 0:42 Month 3 1 letter · From Mama June 30 to July 30 Sunday, July 19, 2026 You smell like warm milk and the lavender soap Papa insists on. I could sit here all night. From Mama Month 2 1 letter · From Mama May 31 to June 29 Wednesday, June 3, 2026 The first weeks 1 letter · From Mama March 31 to April 29 Saturday, April 18, 2026 Asha, you are four days old and the whole house is quiet. Your Nani made dal and nobody ate it because we were all watching you sleep. From Mama 0:42 Tonight Book Family Letter deleted. Undo
lines: Bath time. You splash with your whole body, both hands, both feet, and then you check that I saw.
You rolled over all by yourself, twice, and then looked at me like you had always known how.
You smell like warm milk and the lavender soap Papa insists on. I could sit here all night.
Asha, you are four days old and the whole house is quiet. Your Nani made dal and nobody ate it because we were all watching you sleep.
